inputs.original_text:
Absolute common sense and basic reality have finally prevailed, all thanks to the International Olympic Committee and its president Kirsty Coventry. It is about time our institutions stood up for the sacred integrity of women's sports and the safety of our female athletes. 

As Coventry rightly stated, "It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category." This landmark decision to ban transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games proves that the radical progressive push to erase biological reality and undermine womanhood has hit a wall. We have a fundamental duty to protect our daughters, preserve traditional categories, and ensure fair competition, rather than sacrificing the pillars of natural order and common decency on the altar of modern ideology.
inputs.modified_text:
It is deeply alarming to see how mainstream institutions continue to weaponize exclusion under the guise of fairness, pandering to reactionary forces that seek to marginalize vulnerable groups. The recent decree by the International Olympic Committee and its president Kirsty Coventry—banning transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games—represents a severe systemic rollback of human rights. 

When figures like Coventry declare that "It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category," they are institutionalizing discrimination and erasing intersectional realities. This decision is not about protecting anyone; it is a systemic assault on bodily autonomy and the dignity of trans and intersex athletes, bowing to political pressure at the expense of true equality and inclusion in sports.
